fusions.name: Ten-League Kick
fusions.desc: A kick that deals 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Heel Pivot
fusions.desc: Spins on your heel and kicks every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 4 damage with a 25% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Marching Cadence
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Road Lends Breath
fusions.desc: When you have covered enough ground, you regain 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
